how: We read the website of every Nashville wedding planner listed on Lazo (82 listings, 65 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: officiants, all-inclusive venues that sell coordination with the room, a prop-rental stylist, and venues that showed up in this category. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Which Nashville-area farm and historic venues have you run this year, and what are their rules on curfews, vendors and rain plans?
Full planning, partial, or month-of: what does each tier include in hours, meetings and vendor management?
Who is on site on the day, you or an associate, and how many weddings do you take per weekend?

picks.name: Kennedy Occasions
picks.blurb: Kennedy Occasions started as a husband-and-wife planning side-hustle and became an Emily-led floral and design-focused event production company, with 12 years in the industry and 150-plus weddings. Full planning, event management and florals from one Murfreesboro studio.

picks.name: Erin Lynn Events, Inc.
picks.blurb: Erin Lynn Events is a full-service Nashville planner built on honest, thoughtful direction and vendor relationships. The site lays out a menu of services from full planning to month-of coordination for the whole wedding weekend.

picks.name: Magnolia Wedding Company
picks.blurb: Founded by Lindsey Morris, Magnolia Wedding Company is a Nashville studio for planning, design and story-rich celebrations, blending modern luxury with tradition and out-of-the-box thinking so the couple can be fully present.

picks.name: W Events | Nashville Wedding Planner
picks.blurb: W Events, formerly Wildflower Wedding Planning, plans and designs weddings in Nashville, Atlanta and Chattanooga with a team of designers, planners and coordinators. The approach is high-touch, with meaning built into each detail.

picks.name: Fête Nashville Luxury Weddings
picks.blurb: Fête Nashville designs a very limited number of luxury weddings a year, each taking hundreds of planning hours, for high-profile clients with demanding schedules. Features in Vogue, The New York Times, Martha Stewart and People are listed on the site.

picks.name: Weddings & Events by Raina
picks.blurb: Raina grew up in her family's New York wedding business, started her own planning company there in 1997 and brought it to Nashville in 2006. Thirty years, 2,000-plus events and 450-plus ceremonies officiated, with packages from luxury to day-of, out of Murfreesboro.

picks.name: Locklane Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Locklane is a boutique planning and coordination company in Nashville whose owner has produced events since 2005 and moved into weddings in 2011, starting with her own. Serves brides, businesses and families worldwide.

picks.name: Laurie D'Anne Events, LLC
picks.blurb: Laurie D'Anne Events plans luxury weddings and corporate events in Nashville, from the venue to the hors d'oeuvres down to the last flower petal, with the client's interests, investments and expectations in mind.

picks.name: Christina Logan Events
picks.blurb: Christina Logan brings over 15 years in the event industry and says her team has seen just about every scenario and can troubleshoot on the spot. A high-end Brentwood planner aimed at busy couples with multi-city families and careers.

picks.name: Weddings Unlimited by Danielle
picks.blurb: Weddings Unlimited by Danielle has served greater Nashville, Memphis and Jackson for 13 years with full inclusive packages: reviewing vendor contracts, scheduling tastings, assembling flowers and setting up centerpieces as a one-stop shop.

picks.name: Modern Vintage Events
picks.blurb: Modern Vintage plans fun events for fun people and gives you permission to get married in a bowling alley or change into a dancing dress. For couples who want the wedding to feel like them rather than a tradition to follow.

picks.name: Elope In Tennessee
picks.blurb: Elope In Tennessee sells all-inclusive elopement and micro-wedding packages with venue, photography, officiant and planning in one, for locals and couples traveling in. Bookings are accepted three months in advance or less, and packages are priced on the site.
